verdict.rationale: Visa publishes an official Agent Toolkit SDK (TypeScript) with GitHub repo, Vercel AI SDK integration, and an MCP server, plus REST API docs for building agentic payment flows (visa-intelligent-commerce-docs-10, -17, -18, -20; visa-intelligent-commerce-probe-2). This directly supports AI-native developers building against official SDKs/tools rather than raw APIs alone. Missing for 10: multi-language SDK coverage beyond TypeScript, and independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK usability.
